title: Jagged Steel, the Frenzied Brute - Location, Tactics & Rewards
description: Jagged Steel, the Frenzied Brute in Phantom Blade Zero - where the fight happens, what it drops, and how its attack patterns are countered, including the red and blue flash tells.
keyword: Jagged Steel, the Frenzied Brute phantom blade zero boss

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Jagged Steel, the Frenzied Brute is a story encounter in Prologue & Weeping Creek Valley, found at Rustblade Pavilion bell. Beating it yields Jagged Steel.

sections.title: Where to Find the Jagged Steel, the Frenzied Brute
sections.content:
Location: Rustblade Pavilion bell.

Appears in: Prologue & Weeping Creek Valley.

sections.title: Weaknesses and Counters
sections.content:
There is no weakness table for this fight because there is no damage-type system to fill one in: nothing here resists, absorbs or is immune to anything, and a chart that says otherwise has been inferred from how the boss looks. Read the fight by attack colour instead - red must be dodged, blue must be deflected, purple means it has just parried you and a counter is already coming. The full explanation is on the combat system.

It is mandatory, so it cannot be walked past - the fight is worth learning rather than trying to out-level.

sections.title: How to Beat the Jagged Steel, the Frenzied Brute
sections.content:
What works

  • Stay out of the heavy swing arc and punish the recovery - the weapon is the reward for exactly that.
  • Guard breaks land faster than chip damage here; he armours through light hits.

sections.title: Status
sections.content: No. 3 of 60 in the progression order, in Prologue & Weeping Creek Valley. Before it: The Hunt. After it: Peng Meng, the Axemaster (斧老大 彭猛). The roster by region is on the boss list, and the fights that can be lost by leaving a region early are on the order page. Location and drops come from the shipped game; patch 1.0302256 is the most recent change to any boss behaviour and it touched only Hua.
